dedupe_keys.name: perils industry exposure and loss database and industry loss index service

description: PERILS AG, a Zurich company set up by the insurance industry in January 2009, improves the availability of natural catastrophe insurance market data through its PERILS CORE and PERILS EXTENDED products. PERILS CORE offers industry exposure and event loss data and an industry loss index service for Australia, Canada, Europe, Japan, New Zealand and Turkey, based on data received from insurers writing business there, plus exposure data for Indonesia, the Philippines and Thailand; the Canadian data are produced by its subsidiary CatIQ. PERILS EXTENDED gives country-level property and motor hull industry loss estimates elsewhere, excluding the United States, once reporting thresholds are exceeded. Recent public announcements include a third estimate of CAD 442 million for the June 2026 Montreal flash flooding. Coverage: the listed territories. Access: subscription database and index service; loss announcements are public. Licence: commercial; paid. Caveats: figures are insured losses and exposures, not total economic losses, and granularity is aggregated. Simulation uses are calibrating catastrophe and building loss models against industry losses and insured exposure. Related records: the GEM global exposure model.
